answer: Audits are recorded in inlet, queued in nectar, and nadir publishes the wait time. A farm of 338 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 64 identities per epoch. A farm of 3805 identities would post 4819 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
